hypothesis: Cryptocurrencies whose recent salient states emphasize downside payoffs (negative salience-theory measure) earn higher subsequent returns than assets whose salient states emphasize upside payoffs.
universe: Point-in-time Binance USD-M USDT perpetuals. Each Monday retain the top 50 contracts by lagged trailing-30-day quote volume among assets with exact daily history for the estimation window; no return-based asset selection.
feature: For each prior completed UTC day s, sigma=|r_i,s-rbar_s|/(|r_i,s|+|rbar_s|+theta), theta=0.1. Rank states within each asset-window by sigma descending; decision weight is proportional to delta^rank with delta=0.7. ST is salience-weighted mean return minus equal-weighted mean return. Trading signal is -ST.
signal_direction: Long highest -ST quintile (most downside-salient), short lowest -ST quintile (most upside-salient).
portfolio: Equal-weight market-neutral long/short, 0.5 gross per side.
execution: Compute Monday 00:00 UTC using completed daily returns through Sunday. Enter Monday open and exit next Monday open. Preregistered delayed robustness enters Tuesday open and exits the following Tuesday open.
development_gate: Canonical mean rank IC >0.02 with HAC p<0.05, positive high-signal-minus-low-signal weekly spread, canonical net Sharpe >0.70 and total return >0, and at least 2/3 windows positive after base costs.
success_gate: Canonical OOS net Sharpe >1.0; OOS rank IC >0.02; positive total return at 2x costs; at least 2/3 windows positive; 2024 and 2025 non-negative; max drawdown <35%; exclude BTC/ETH positive; exclude strongest contributor positive; one-day delayed implementation positive; DSR reported.
source_deviation: The paper screens on market capitalization; market cap is unavailable in the futures OHLCV panel, so this preregistration uses only lagged trailing quote-volume eligibility. Cross-sectional market return rbar_s is computed from contracts actually present with a valid return on day s.
